The Base Cherngtalay

Condominium in Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale), Thalang
HomeSaleThe Base Cherngtalay

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

The Base Cherngtalay is a low-rise condominium by Sansiri in Cherng Talay, Phuket, on a site of about 4 rai. It comprises two 8-storey buildings with 341 one- and two-bedroom apartments of roughly 27 to 63 sqm. Units are sold furnished, and the project offers a pool, fitness center, co-working lounge, co-kitchen, organic farm and onsen.

The Base Cherngtalay: key facts

  • The Base Cherngtalay is a low-rise condominium in Cherng Talay, Phuket, developed by Sansiri.
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 27–63 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Jun 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,720,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bang Tao Beach (8 min, driving); Laguna Golf Club and Blue Tree Phuket (10 min, driving); International schools (7 min, driving); Phuket International Airport (30 min, driving).
  • More projects by Sansiri in our catalogue: Dcondo Reef Kathu, BRISA Patong by Sansiri, The Tales Story One - Bangjo.
